2608.21829.title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores
2608.21829.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation treats the document store as a frozen input, and the systems that instead let an agent curate one never measure what curation does to the store. We invert the framing: the knowledge base is the model. A training agent answers a supervised question against the current store, is shown the gold, then edits the store; an unchanged reader is later examined on a frozen snapshot under a fixed action budget. Where offline graph construction is unsupervised, (question, answer) pairs are our labels -- and that supervision is what makes the structure cheap. Per point of corpus indexed it returns 1.6x the action saving and 1.8x the accuracy of an unsupervised entity index covering everything, using 1,913 links against its 196,112. On questions the store trained on, an unchanged reader spends 31% fewer actions at higher accuracy, and the result reproduces on an official PhantomWiki generation whose questions we did not write. To measure how far this reaches we introduce a key-coverage gradient, a probe varying how much of a question the training set touched, replacing a train/test split's pass/fail with a decay curve. Generalization proves endpoint-dependent: accuracy carries to unseen questions (+0.167 F1 where both of a question's keys were indexed, +0.100 where one was, zero where neither) while the action saving stays on trained questions. Because that decay is indexed by coverage rather than by novelty, more training extends it -- and the store is undertrained, not saturated: coverage grows linearly in new questions and stops the moment training repeats them, so a hundred questions reach a quarter of the corpus and four times as many would close the gap.
2608.21829.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成將文檔存儲視為靜態輸入，而那些讓代理人策劃文檔存儲的系統卻從未衡量策劃對存儲的影響。我們反轉了這一框架：知識庫就是模型。一個訓練代理人針對當前存儲回答一個監督問題，然後顯示正確答案，接著編輯存儲；一個未改變的讀者在固定的行動預算下，稍後會在一個靜態快照上進行檢查。在離線圖構建中是無監督的，(問題，答案)對是我們的標籤——而這種監督使得結構變得便宜。每個索引的語料點返回1.6倍的行動節省和1.8倍的準確率，這是針對一個覆蓋所有內容的無監督實體索引，使用1,913個鏈接對比其196,112。在存儲訓練的問題上，一個未改變的讀者以更高的準確率花費31%的行動更少，而這一結果在一個官方的PhantomWiki生成中重現，該生成的問題我們並未撰寫。為了測量這一影響的範圍，我們引入了一個關鍵覆蓋梯度，一個探針變化訓練集觸及問題的程度，用衰減曲線取代訓練/測試分割的通過/失敗。泛化證明是端點依賴的：準確率對未見過的問題有影響（當一個問題的兩個鍵都被索引時，F1增加0.167；當一個被索引時，增加0.100；當兩者都未被索引時，則為零），而行動節省則保持在訓練過的問題上。因為這種衰減是由覆蓋率而非新穎性所指標化的，因此更多的訓練會延伸它——而存儲是未充分訓練的，而非飽和的：在新問題中的覆蓋率線性增長，並在訓練重複時停止，因此一百個問題達到四分之一的語料，而四倍的問題將縮小這一差距。
2608.21829.author: Yu Pan et.al.
